responsive.layout: Single column stacking on mobile, reflowing to multi-column bento grids on desktop. Ensure heavy visuals don't dominate the viewport on small screens.
responsive.typography: Fluid scaling. Headings scale down on mobile (max text-4xl), body stays comfortably legible. Inputs large enough to avoid mobile zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: Constrain flex/grid children and prevent unintended horizontal scrolling by using overflow-hidden on main wrappers.
responsive.tap_targets: Interactive elements must be a minimum of 44x44px for comfortable tapping.

headings.hierarchy: H1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl, H2: text-3xl md:text-4xl, H3: text-xl md:text-2xl

labels.classes: text-xs md:text-sm font-semibold tracking-widest uppercase text-slate-500

layouts.marketing: Use generous padding (py-16 to py-24). Bento grid patterns for features/programs. Overlapping elements for visual interest.
layouts.dashboard: Dense, clean structural monochrome with gold accents. Strict grid hierarchy. Sidebar navigation for desktop, bottom bar or hamburger for mobile.
layouts.spacing: p-1, p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24. Containers with borders MUST have p-6 or p-8.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle, elegant shadows: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] for cards, stronger shadow for floating elements.
visual_enhancers.borders: rounded-2xl for main cards, 1px border-slate-100 to border-slate-200. No harsh black borders.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Subtle linear gradients using Navy and Gold for accent backgrounds. No full-screen generic gradients.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for sticky headers: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200/50.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or smooth rounded (rounded-xl). Primary: Navy background, White text. Secondary: Outline Gold or White with soft shadow. Include hover states and active translations (-translate-y-0.5).
components.cards: Flat white backgrounds with soft shadows. Ensure sufficient padding.
components.header: Sticky navigation, Crystal Glass (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md), prominent Login buttons.
components.forms: Clean inputs, Shadcn standard but heavily styled to match the clean elegant theme. rounded-lg borders.
components.logo: Create a custom inline SVG for the logo: A five-point navy star with a gold diagonal swoosh across it and a smaller gold star near the top right.

hero.description: Students in a modern learning environment. Use with a subtle dark or gradient overlay to ensure text contrast.

announcements.description: Modern academy building to use as thumbnail for announcements.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building KABUL STAR ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACADEMY. English language only.
The app has a public marketing homepage and 3 dashboard shells (Student, Teacher, Manager).
Public Homepage Sections: Hero, About Academy, Programs Pathway, Latest Announcements, Contact.
Header must include: Logo + Navigation (Home, About, Programs, Announcements, Contact) + Three distinct Login buttons (Student, Teacher, Manager).
Hero Text: 'KABUL STAR ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACADEMY', 'Together for a Brighter Future', 'Come to Learn, Leave to Serve'.
Programs section must show the pathway: Pre-Beginner -> Beginner -> Book 1 -> Book 2 -> ... -> Book 12 -> PELP.
Build a generic Login Page that handles role selection.
Build empty stubs (shells) for Manager, Teacher, and Student dashboards with a sidebar.
MANDATORY: Implement mobile-first responsive design. Stack columns on mobile.
MANDATORY: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for the header. Use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent white background.
MANDATORY: Ensure high contrast ratios for all text. Use navy blue for primary text, not light grays.
MANDATORY: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
MANDATORY: Create a custom SVG for the academy logo based on the description in the components section.
Use Lucide React for generic icons.
Use Framer Motion for scroll animations and micro-interactions on the landing page.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
